# Optional local 9Router account routing: run scripts/install-model-router.py,
# then open Settings -> Models & accounts. Both processes use this same file.
# Default: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/augmentagent/model-router.json (or ~/.config/...).
# AUGMENTAGENT_MODEL_ROUTER_CONFIG=/absolute/private/path/model-router.json

# =============================================================================
# AugmentAgent environment — copy to `.env` (gitignored) and fill in.
# Linux daemon host. Values here are PLACEHOLDERS only — never commit secrets.
#
# Gating philosophy: every channel that can post/DM/act on a real account is
# INERT until explicitly armed below. Defaults are safe (off / dry).
# =============================================================================

# --- Core API keys -----------------------------------------------------------
GROQ_API_KEY=
CEREBRAS_API_KEY=
COMPOSIO_API_KEY=
# Dashboard login key. Empty => the dashboard generates one, stores it, and
# prints it once on first start. e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`.
AUGMENTAGENT_API_KEY=
# 1 => failed drafts never file GitHub issues through `gh`. Keep 1 unless
# `gh` is logged in to YOUR fork.
AUGMENTAGENT_GH_DISABLE=1
# Linux installer manages this through the daemon unit. Keep unset for manual
# or macOS serving; it selects the independent worker without enabling auto-PR.
# AUGMENTAGENT_AUTOPR_EXTERNAL=1
# Mistral OCR (#939): stage-2 fallback for scanned (image-only) PDF
# attachments — Discord drops, `gmail get-attachment`, `doc extract`. Unset ⇒
# the OCR stage is skipped and the extraction reports "OCR unavailable"
# instead of a silent blank. Keyring-first like the other provider keys.
MISTRAL_API_KEY=
# AUGMENTAGENT_MISTRAL_OCR_MODEL=mistral-ocr-latest
# AUGMENTAGENT_MISTRAL_BASE_URL=https://api.mistral.ai
# SocialAPI.ai — managed social-account posting/engagement (#238). Auto-masked.
SOCIALAPI_API_KEY=
# CCat / SeaCat decision gate. Disabled by default. When enabled, only the
# comma-separated remote names listed below are treated as public and gated.
# The key is keyring-first at runtime; this env fallback is for local hosts.
SEACAT_API_KEY=
# Separate 32+ byte owner secret used to sign one-time CCAP push receipts.
# Generate once with `openssl rand -hex 32`; never share it with an agent.
CCAT_APPROVAL_SIGNING_KEY=
AUGMENTAGENT_CCAT_ENABLED=false
AUGMENTAGENT_CCAT_PUBLIC_REMOTES=
# Private JSONL from a labelled CCat evaluation. The public-push hook requires
# >=100 examples and zero false allows; see scripts/ccat-calibrate.py.
AUGMENTAGENT_CCAT_CALIBRATION_REPORT=
# OPTIONAL (#248, default OFF): expose SocialAPI.ai's MCP server to the draft
# reasoner as a STRICTLY READ-ONLY drafting aid (fetch comment/thread context).
# A PreToolUse hook fail-closes any write/send/reply/post/dm/delete tool. Set
# to 1/true/yes/on to enable. Leave unset for unchanged behavior.
# AUGMENTAGENT_SOCIALAPI_MCP_READONLY=
# Optional override for the SocialAPI MCP endpoint (defaults to the v1 /mcp path).
# AUGMENTAGENT_SOCIALAPI_MCP_URL=

# --- Discord (approval + notification surface — REQUIRED) --------------------
# Without Discord creds the agent still polls, but CANNOT surface approval
# cards, #58 engagement previews, self-improve approval prompts, or nudges —
# every approval-gated feature is dark. Provision with:
#   augmentagent discord login --creds-json <file>
# or place the creds JSON at the path the systemd unit exports via
# AUGMENTAGENT_DISCORD_CREDS (default: ~/.config/augmentagent/discord-creds.json).
DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN=
DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID=
# Also carries the source-watchdog alarm (#1463): a data-source store cold past
# WATCHDOG_ALARM_AGE_S posts here, throttled to one message per
# WATCHDOG_ALARM_NOTIFY_INTERVAL_S (default 86400) per app.
DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=
# Requires MESSAGE CONTENT intent enabled for the bot in the Discord dev portal.
DISCORD_QUERY_CHANNEL_ID=        # optional — defaults to DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID
DISCORD_ALLOWED_USER_ID=         # your Discord user ID; others are ignored
DISCORD_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_SECS=3600

# --- Auto-update signature gate (security #298) ---------------------------
# Applies ONLY to the legacy TS updater (src/index.ts) and the dashboard's
# GitHub-webhook deploy. scripts/check-for-updates.sh (the systemd timer) does
# NOT verify signatures — point it only at your own fork.
# The auto-updater pulls/builds/restarts the revision on origin/main every 5 min
# on a credential-bearing host. To prevent deploying spoofed/unverified code, the
# target revision MUST be cryptographically signed by an allowlisted (owner) key
# before any pull/build/restart. The git author field is NOT trusted.
#
# Path to an SSH/GPG allowed-signers file containing the owner's public key. This
# is the trust anchor. Used via `git -c gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile=...` for
# verify-tag / verify-commit. If unset, git's already-configured signer trust is
# used (a warning is logged).
AUGMENTAGENT_UPDATE_ALLOWED_SIGNERS=
# Require a valid owner signature before auto-deploying (default: enforce).
# Set to "false" ONLY if you cannot sign releases; this disables the gate.
AUGMENTAGENT_UPDATE_REQUIRE_SIGNATURE=true

# --- Dashboard ---------------------------------------------------------------
DASHBOARD_PORT=3000
IMPORTANT_SENDERS=email1@example.com,email2@example.com

# --- Dev-tool webhooks (#49) -------------------------------------------------
GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET=           # openssl rand -hex 32

# --- Daily research pipeline (augmentagent research) -------------------------
# Pulls recent arXiv AI/agent papers + latest leapmodel commits, compares them
# against our agent process via a SWAPPABLE LLM driver, files GitHub issues for
# the top gaps, and posts a digest to Discord. All keys optional (defaults shown).
# RESEARCH_LLM_CMD reads a prompt on stdin and returns {"gaps":[…]} on stdout;
# swap it for `codex exec`, `ollama run <model>`, or any OpenAI-compatible shim.
RESEARCH_LLM_CMD="claude -p --output-format json"
RESEARCH_ARXIV_CATEGORIES=cs.AI,cs.MA,cs.CL,cs.LG
RESEARCH_KEYWORDS="agent,tool use,multi-agent,rag,planning,reflection,memory,llm,reasoning"
RESEARCH_MAX_PAPERS=15            # cap papers/day after keyword rank+dedup
RESEARCH_MAX_ISSUES=3            # cap auto-filed issues/day (--max-issues overrides)
RESEARCH_GH_REPO=                 # owner/repo of YOUR fork; never upstream
# RESEARCH_FETCH_BATCH=100       # arXiv entries pulled before filtering

# --- Reasoner provider chain & model tiers (#655/#658) -----------------------
# Every value below is COMMENTED OUT and shows the built-in default, so an
# unedited copy behaves exactly like a checkout with none of this set. #658
# also asked for CLAUDE.md, but that file is host-local operator notes with
# operator PII and is deliberately untracked (.gitignore, #305) — so it can
# carry no shared docs, and this block plus README.md stand in for it.
#
# The chain the reasoner walks, in order; the first success wins. Default is
# claude alone — failover is opt-in. A provider only ever serves calls its
# capability class allows: Claude and Codex support full-agentic workflows;
# Codex uses the scoped, guarded tool bridge (docs/CODEX-FALLBACK.md).
# Cerebras is text-only; Gemini also supports read-only file tools.
# Put codex first to use it as primary, or use codex alone without Claude.
# Unknown names are skipped with a warning (and flagged by `doctor`).
# AUGMENTAGENT_REASONER_CHAIN=claude
#
# Per-provider tier -> model map. Presets ask for a tier (Quality for triage /
# drafts / digest / ask, Fast for parsers and classifiers); these cells decide
# which concrete model each provider runs for it. Swap a model without a
# rebuild by uncommenting a cell.
# AUGMENTAGENT_MODEL_CLAUDE_QUALITY=claude-opus-4-8
# AUGMENTAGENT_MODEL_CLAUDE_FAST=claude-haiku-4-5-20251001
# AUGMENTAGENT_MODEL_CODEX_QUALITY=gpt-5.6-terra
# AUGMENTAGENT_MODEL_CODEX_FAST=gpt-5.6-luna
# AUGMENTAGENT_MODEL_GEMINI_QUALITY=gemini-3.1-pro-preview
# AUGMENTAGENT_MODEL_GEMINI_FAST=gemini-3.7-flash
# AUGMENTAGENT_MODEL_CEREBRAS_QUALITY=gpt-oss-120b
# AUGMENTAGENT_MODEL_CEREBRAS_FAST=gemma-4-31b
#
# Cerebras retires model families several times a year, so `augmentagent
# doctor --deep` checks its catalog for the two pins above — but only while
# cerebras is actually named in the chain.
# AUGMENTAGENT_CEREBRAS_BASE_URL=https://api.cerebras.ai/v1
#
# One live round trip through the chain, printing the providers, the active
# cooldown latches and the response:  augmentagent reasoner-selftest

# --- Rust runtime knobs ------------------------------------------------------
RUST_LOG=info
# CLAUDE_CLI=claude              # override path to the `claude` binary
# AUGMENTAGENT_DB=./data.db      # defaults to ./data.db
# NOTE: the encrypted sparsebundle vault is macOS-only and NOT used on this
# Linux host — vault-mount.sh is a no-op here. (Linux-only deployment.)

# --- Codex build-VM scratch admission limits (#1092) -------------------------
# Read from the DAEMON environment only (never a task/profile env or the model)
# and carried to the bridge in its private policy. A new build session is
# admitted only within these limits. Values are integer GiB; unset or blank
# falls back to the default, but a value that is present and out-of-range or
# unparseable fails closed (doctor's `build_scratch` check flags them) — never
# silently defaulted or clamped. On this host the defaults admit one session at
# a time: the 24 GiB budget would by itself fit two 12 GiB images, but the
# free-space rule is binding (a second concurrent session needs more free space
# than the volume has). The scratch volume (default /mnt/build/codex-vm) is
# shared with the auto-PR gate cache: if AUGMENTAGENT_GATE_CACHE_MAX_MB grows
# the cache, less free space is left for build sessions. See docs/BUILD-VM.md.
# AUGMENTAGENT_BUILD_SCRATCH_HEADROOM_GIB=20   # free space kept after admitting a session (min 4)
# AUGMENTAGENT_BUILD_SCRATCH_IMAGE_CAP_GIB=12  # per-session build-cache image cap (min 10)
# AUGMENTAGENT_BUILD_SCRATCH_BUDGET_GIB=24     # total build-cache budget across sessions (>= image cap)

# --- Automated git commit identity (#118 — daemon self-improve/wiki commits) -
# Neutral default if unset: "AugmentAgent <augmentagent@localhost>".
# Also used for private KB-mirror sync commits (epic #474).
AUGMENTAGENT_GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=
AUGMENTAGENT_GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=

# --- Private knowledge-base mirror (epic #474) ---
# `wiki/` is its own git repo backed by a PRIVATE GitHub repo so the owner
# can browse/edit the KB from anywhere. Bootstrap once with
# `scripts/kb-mirror-bootstrap.sh [repo-name]`; ongoing sync runs via the
# augmentagent-wiki-sync.timer systemd unit. Auth is the ambient `gh`
# login (no token here). The sync itself needs nothing here — the remote is
# stored in wiki/.git/config and commit identity comes from the git-author
# vars above.
#
# AUGMENTAGENT_WIKI_REMOTE: optional. The KB repo as a full URL or an
# `owner/repo` slug. Only used to render the dashboard's "Knowledge base"
# link (#479); leave unset to hide the link.
AUGMENTAGENT_WIKI_REMOTE=

# --- Web-fetch sidecar (layered URL fetcher) ---
# Layer order: http → render (headless Playwright) → firecrawl → brightdata.
# Each provider layer is skipped if its key is unset. The local HTTP + render
# layers always run, so a basic install has zero new external deps.
# FETCH_SOCKET=                  # override the sidecar Unix-socket path
# FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=             # https://firecrawl.dev — falls back when local render fails
# BRIGHTDATA_API_KEY=            # https://brightdata.com — final fallback for anti-bot sites
# BRIGHTDATA_ZONE=               # bright data Unlocker zone name; required alongside the key
# FETCH_DRY_PROVIDERS=1          # set to 1 to skip real Firecrawl / Bright Data calls (testing)

# --- Claude Intercept (optional, local MITM proxy at ~/claude_intercept) ---
# CLAUDE_INTERCEPT_CLI=          # override path to the intercept CLI (default ~/claude_intercept/src/cli.js)

# =============================================================================
# CHANNEL ARMING GATES — all default OFF. Un-gating each also needs the live
# credential (cookies / token) and, where noted, a one-time validation run.
# =============================================================================

# --- Instagram (#50/#76/#112/#119/#128) --------------------------------------
# Browser-driven feed/carousel/reel/story posting + DM. Approval-gated, hard
# daily quota. Set true ONLY after `instagram validate` passes on a live
# session (needs IG session cookies via the browser sidecar).
INSTAGRAM_REAL_ACCOUNT_ENABLED=false

# --- Twitter / X (#14/#107/#126/#129) ----------------------------------------
# No live x.com call happens unless you pass `--allow-live`. Final sign-off:
#   augmentagent twitter validate --allow-live true   (needs auth_token + ct0)
# AUGMENTAGENT_TWITTER_BASE_URL=   # testing only — mock/capture-proxy override

# --- Deft / Deftform (#116/#121/#127) ----------------------------------------
# Inert until BOTH are set. Then register the webhook in the Deftform portal:
#   POST https://<host>/webhooks/deft/<AUGMENTAGENT_DEFT_WEBHOOK_SECRET>
# and capture a live submission to validate the envelope (docs/deft-protocol.md §4).
AUGMENTAGENT_DEFT_ENABLED=
AUGMENTAGENT_DEFT_WEBHOOK_SECRET=   # openssl rand -hex 32 (carried in URL path)

# --- WhatsApp (#12/#102/#110) ------------------------------------------------
# Triple ban-risk gate. Also needs the whatsmeow sidecar QR-paired.
AUGMENTAGENT_WHATSAPP_CONTROL_ENABLED=
AUGMENTAGENT_WHATSAPP_CONTROL_CHAT=   # the single designated control chat id

# --- Telegram bot (#74/#91) --------------------------------------------------
AUGMENTAGENT_TELEGRAM_OWNER_CHAT_ID=
# AUGMENTAGENT_TELEGRAM_BOT_AUTH=   # file fallback for headless/CI (else keyring)

# --- LinkedIn posting (#13/#51/#109) -----------------------------------------
# First 3 posts require a second confirmation; set to clear that guard.
AUGMENTAGENT_LINKEDIN_POST_CONFIRM=   # =yes to confirm

# =============================================================================
# OPT-IN FEATURE FLAGS — off by default; safe to enable incrementally.
# =============================================================================

# --- Ask-detection resolvers (#35/#115/#120/#130) ----------------------------
# off (default) | shadow (Haiku telemetry, no draft injection) | live
AUGMENTAGENT_ASK_RESOLVE=off
AUGMENTAGENT_ASK_RESOLVE_MIN_CONFIDENCE=0.7
# Each live resolver also self-gates on its own flag (no flag ⇒ no-op):
AUGMENTAGENT_ASK_RESOLVE_SCHEDULING=
AUGMENTAGENT_ASK_RESOLVE_CALENDLY=
AUGMENTAGENT_ASK_RESOLVE_SHARE_DOC=
AUGMENTAGENT_ASK_RESOLVE_INTRO=
AUGMENTAGENT_ASK_RESOLVE_MEETING_LINK=
AUGMENTAGENT_CALENDLY_URL=        # used by the calendly resolver
AUGMENTAGENT_MEETING_LINK=        # static Zoom/Meet/Teams link fallback

# --- Drafting (#106) ---------------------------------------------------------
AUGMENTAGENT_THREAD_AWARE=        # DEFAULT-ON (#450); =0 to draft without thread history
AUGMENTAGENT_DRAFT_ARCHETYPES=    # =1 draft archetypes
# AUGMENTAGENT_MAX_PENDING_DRAFTS — REMOVED in #450. It downgraded Reply→Flag
# (no draft at all) once the queue passed a cap, and because the queue could not
# drain on its own it became a permanent kill switch for drafting. Volume is now
# controlled at the source: bulk senders never reach the draft phase (#451) and
# answered cards retire themselves (#449).
AUGMENTAGENT_STALE_DRAFT_DAYS=7      # hourly sweep expires pending older than this

# --- Approval-queue hygiene (#449) -------------------------------------------
# Watches the SENT folder so a reply you write in Gmail web/mobile retires the
# pending approval card on that thread. DEFAULT-ON; =0 disables (and the
# carousel will then keep showing mail you have already answered).
AUGMENTAGENT_OUTBOUND_OBSERVER=
AUGMENTAGENT_OUTBOUND_OBSERVER_INTERVAL_SECS=   # default 300

# --- Contacts / CRM ingestion (#61/#62/#64/#113) -----------------------------
# AUGMENTAGENT_CARDDAV_URL=
# AUGMENTAGENT_CARDDAV_USER=
# AUGMENTAGENT_CARDDAV_PASS=
AUGMENTAGENT_DEFAULT_REGION=US    # E.164 phone normalization default region

# Journal privacy (#1055): extra excluded topics (comma-separated, exact
# case-insensitive match) on top of the built-ins (password variants + the
# lock emoji). Entries in an excluded topic are consumed but never stored.
# AUGMENTAGENT_JOURNAL_EXCLUDE_TOPICS=

# --- iMessage history bundle (#882) ------------------------------------------
# Private iMessage bundle directory (does not need to be a Git repository).
# Exporter + macOS scheduler: scripts/imessage/; setup: docs/IMESSAGE.md.
# Existing private Git bundles still auto-pull. Absent = feature off.
# AUGMENTAGENT_IMESSAGE_REPO_DIR=
# Optional S3 bucket/prefix holding the bundle's attachment files (#888).
# Also the ask-mode `imessage fetch-attachment` allowlist; setting the bucket forwards AWS_* into the ask env.
# AUGMENTAGENT_IMESSAGE_S3_BUCKET=
# AUGMENTAGENT_IMESSAGE_S3_PREFIX=conversations/
# Auto-merge duplicate contacts: a `*_at_contact` stub whose phone/email sits on
# exactly ONE person page is merged without an approval card, and one Discord
# digest lists what merged. Pairs you rejected stay rejected; a survivor named
# after a bare phone number still gets a card. Default off (card per pair).
# AUGMENTAGENT_AUTO_MERGE_CONTACTS=true

# --- WhatsApp Desktop conversation history ----------------------------------
# Private bundle directory: plain folder or existing private Git checkout.
# The daemon pulls Git feeds and imports history on startup/every 30 minutes.
# No live WhatsApp pairing, triage, or outbound sends are enabled by this setting.
# Exporter + macOS scheduler: scripts/whatsapp/; setup: docs/WHATSAPP-HISTORY.md.
# AUGMENTAGENT_WHATSAPP_HISTORY_DIR=

# --- Apple Notes bundle (#1062) --------------------------------------------
# Private git checkout produced by scripts/apple-notes/ (setup: docs/APPLE-NOTES.md).
# The daemon pulls it and imports new/edited/deleted notes every 30 minutes into
# searchable history (platform "apple_notes"). Absent = feature off.
# AUGMENTAGENT_APPLE_NOTES_REPO_DIR=
# Optional private S3 bucket/prefix holding the bundle's attachment files (#1061),
# uploaded by `scripts/apple-notes/sync.py --s3-bucket` under an IAM profile that
# may only write there. Also the ask-mode `apple-notes fetch-attachment` allowlist;
# setting the bucket forwards AWS_* into the ask env. Absent = the verb reports
# "not configured" and makes no network call.
# AUGMENTAGENT_APPLE_NOTES_S3_BUCKET=
# AUGMENTAGENT_APPLE_NOTES_S3_PREFIX=notes/

# --- Discord history (#1054) -------------------------------------------------
# Opt-in: sync Discord messages into searchable conversation history (no model
# calls). Needs `augmentagent discord login`. Runs every ~4 h in the daemon;
# `augmentagent discord history-sync` runs it now. Setup: docs/DISCORD-HISTORY.md.
# 1 = include your DMs and group DMs.
# AUGMENTAGENT_DISCORD_EXPORT_DMS=0
# Comma-separated server (guild) ids whose readable text channels are included.
# Find ids with `augmentagent discord list-guilds`.
# AUGMENTAGENT_DISCORD_EXPORT_GUILDS=

# 1 = send new iMessage/WhatsApp history messages and new/edited Apple Notes through LLM wiki capture
# (one Haiku call per changed conversation per poll). Default off: rows stay searchable.
# AUGMENTAGENT_HISTORY_WIKI_CAPTURE=0

# =============================================================================
# MULTI-TENANT (#101) — per-Discord-server isolated agents.
# See docs/MULTI-TENANT.md (Phase D runbook). Each tenant sets its own
# DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID + Composio Drive OAuth; runs with `--no-email`.
# =============================================================================

# --- Wix Events calendar mirror (#633) ---------------------------------------
# Mirrors upcoming Meetup group events onto a Wix Events calendar. CREATE ONLY —
# the job never updates or deletes. Key: https://manage.wix.com/account/api-keys
# with Wix Events "Manage Events" + "Read Events".
# AUGMENTAGENT_WIX_API_KEY=
# AUGMENTAGENT_WIX_SITE_ID=
# AUGMENTAGENT_WIX_MEETUP_GROUPS=philadelphia-entrepreneur   # comma-separated slugs
# Luma calendars to mirror (comma-separated cal-… ids). Auth-free ICS feed;
# find the id in any event page's __NEXT_DATA__ as "api_id":"cal-…".
# AUGMENTAGENT_WIX_LUMA_CALENDARS=cal-wtGdKVWfiMGaxqD
AUGMENTAGENT_WIX_SYNC_DRY_RUN=1              # plan only unless --yes
AUGMENTAGENT_WIX_SYNC_MAX_PER_RUN=5          # cap creations per run
AUGMENTAGENT_WIX_SYNC_REQUIRE_APPROVAL=1     # a timer can only ever plan
AUGMENTAGENT_WIX_TIMEZONE=America/New_York

# --- Heartbeat (#1317) — see docs/HEARTBEAT.md ---
# A periodic open-ended check-in against <wiki>/HEARTBEAT.md. Silent unless
# something needs you; skipped (no model call) when the checklist is missing
# or empty. Off unless enabled.
AUGMENTAGENT_HEARTBEAT_ENABLED=0
# AUGMENTAGENT_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=30m          # 5m floor
# AUGMENTAGENT_HEARTBEAT_ACTIVE_HOURS=08:00-22:00   # unset = all day; may cross midnight
# AUGMENTAGENT_HEARTBEAT_TZ=America/New_York   # unset = host local time
# AUGMENTAGENT_HEARTBEAT_DAILY_CAP=6           # max notices per rolling 24h
# AUGMENTAGENT_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_SECS=300      # one model call's budget

# --- FlyOnTheWall meeting transcripts (#915) ---
# A read-only clone of the private transcript repo FlyOnTheWall auto-pushes to.
# `transcripts sync` fast-forwards it and ingests new meetings; the ask agent
# also gets read access so it can grep what was actually said.
AUGMENTAGENT_TRANSCRIPTS_DIR=
# Your own address(es), comma-separated; every one is excluded from any
# meeting roster (you can be invited under a work domain, a personal gmail,
# and the export account all at once).
AUGMENTAGENT_MY_EMAIL=

# Plaid personal finance. Trial accounts use production; sandbox is fake data.
PLAID_CLIENT_ID=
PLAID_SECRET=
PLAID_ENV=production
# Item access tokens are stored in Linux Secret Service, never in the wiki.

# --- Disk hygiene for build output (#1406) — see docs/disk-storage.md ----------------
# `augmentagent disk prune` (daily timer) removes build output no compile has
# needed lately; it never touches a target dir a running build is using.
# AUGMENTAGENT_PRUNE_ARTIFACT_DAYS=7       # days without a compile needing a unit
# AUGMENTAGENT_PRUNE_INCREMENTAL_DAYS=2    # idle days for an incremental/ session
# AUGMENTAGENT_PRUNE_TARGET_DIRS=          # extra target dirs, colon-separated
# AUGMENTAGENT_GATE_MIN_FREE_GB=15         # final free-space reserve; monitored during builds
# AUGMENTAGENT_BUILD_GROWTH_GB=10          # additional peak growth reserved before build admission
# AUGMENTAGENT_BUILD_PARENT=              # session cache parent; wrapper prefers writable /mnt/build
# AUGMENTAGENT_GATE_CACHE_MAX_MB=20000     # shared cache cap, enforced under the storage lease
# AUGMENTAGENT_GATE_CACHE_STALE_DAYS=3     # idle days before a cap trim takes an artifact
# AUGMENTAGENT_DEPLOY_MAX_GB=8             # owner's snapshot budget; over it, oldest unprotected snapshots are evicted (agents: never raise it to pass a refusal)
# AUGMENTAGENT_DEPLOY_KEEP=2               # deploy snapshots / rollback binaries kept regardless of age
# AUGMENTAGENT_DEPLOY_SNAPSHOT_DIR=        # where `deploy snapshot` writes (default: the data dir)
# AUGMENTAGENT_ACTION_BODY_RETENTION_DAYS=30 # days a terminal action keeps its own copy of the email body (0 disables)
# AUGMENTAGENT_LOG_ROTATE_MB=50            # rotate a state-dir log at this size (or monthly)
# AUGMENTAGENT_LOG_KEEP_MONTHS=3           # months a rotated log is kept locally
# AUGMENTAGENT_OPS_ARCHIVE_REMOTE=         # owner/repo of a PRIVATE GitHub repo for rotated logs; unset = off

# Optional: pin the Composio auth config used when connecting a toolkit from the
# dashboard (COMPOSIO_AUTH_CONFIG_<TOOLKIT>, e.g. GMAIL, GOOGLECALENDAR,
# GOOGLEDRIVE). Point it at an auth config backed by your own Google OAuth app
# so tool calls count against Composio's full plan allowance instead of the
# smaller managed-app allowance.
#COMPOSIO_AUTH_CONFIG_GMAIL=

# Direct Google access (#1573): connect Gmail through your OWN Google OAuth
# client and skip Composio for those mailboxes entirely. In Google Cloud:
# enable the Gmail, Calendar, Drive and People APIs; set the OAuth consent
# screen to External + In production (Testing expires refresh tokens after 7
# days); create a "Web application" client whose authorized redirect URI is
# http://localhost:<DASHBOARD_PORT>/oauth/google/callback. With both set, the
# dashboard's "Add Gmail" goes through Google; each connected mailbox's refresh
# token is kept in the private credential store. See docs/google-oauth.md.
#GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID=
#GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=
# Optional: an https origin that reaches this dashboard from other devices (a
# Tailscale Serve hostname, a reverse proxy). When set, Google consents redirect
# to <origin>/oauth/google/callback — register that URI on the OAuth client too —
# so a connect can be approved from a phone. Unset = localhost only.
#AUGMENTAGENT_PUBLIC_URL=
# Optional: pin the exact redirect URI instead (overrides the two derivations
# above). Must be registered on the OAuth client byte for byte.
#GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI=

# Optional: Gmail inbound poll cadence for `serve` (seconds, default 300).
#AUGMENTAGENT_GMAIL_POLL_SECS=300

# Optional incoming calls to the configured Twilio number. PIN: 4–12 digits.
# These three settings also accept `augmentagent env set KEY VALUE` (restart required).
#AUGMENTAGENT_PHONE_INBOUND_PIN=
#AUGMENTAGENT_PHONE_INBOUND_PLATFORM=discord
#AUGMENTAGENT_PHONE_INBOUND_ACCOUNT=

# Trusted-contact autonomy (#1833). Only the value `on` enables it; read once
# at startup (pause live with `augmentagent trust pause-all`). The trusted
# people live in config/trusted-contacts.toml (written by `augmentagent trust`);
# set AUGMENTAGENT_TRUSTED_CONTACTS to use another path. Heartbeat outreach to
# full-tier contacts also needs AUGMENTAGENT_AUTONOMY=on.
AUGMENTAGENT_AUTONOMY=off
AUGMENTAGENT_TRUSTED_CONTACTS=
AUGMENTAGENT_HEARTBEAT_OUTREACH=off
# Email outreach goes out from the mailbox that last received mail from the
# contact; this picks one (address or entity id) when none has.
AUGMENTAGENT_OUTREACH_GMAIL_ACCOUNT=
